title: Clarifying Your First Sync for a team

question.author: member_115
question.body: Before I explain your first sync to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Getting Started documentation says: The tray icon shows sync state: green when up to date, spinning blue while syncing, red on errors. Right-click the icon to pause, open preferences, or check sync activity. After signing in to a desktop client, CloudBox creates a local CloudBox folder. Anything you put inside it syncs to the cloud and to your other devices; anything you put in the cloud appears in the folder. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
